source_contract.authority: tracked post-R136 research and roadmap decision at d4373eb

branch_decisions.reason: it is the smallest successor that can couple q/v/a, exact reachable effort and rigid contact force without changing modes or materials
sliding, compliance, contact-implicit mode choice or altered native semantics widen the correspondence surface before fixed-mode feasibility is known
R136 already produced a complete numerically valid 3200-row infeasibility map and cannot retry
an independently chosen torque trajectory would bypass the exact fixed-PD limiter graph exercised by R133 and R136

fixed_contact_semantics_contract.contact_schedule: exact R131/R136 left-owned two-foot mode sequence at all 800 motor intervals
fixed_contact_semantics_contract.point_identity: exact R113 left heel/forefoot then right heel/forefoot ordinals 0/1/2/3
fixed_contact_semantics_contract.active_anchor: each initially active or newly activated point retains its source world anchor for its complete active episode
fixed_contact_semantics_contract.sticking_constraints: active point position equals its source anchor and J(q)v=0 at every owned state node; J(q)a+Jdot(q,v)v=0 on every owned continuous interval
fixed_contact_semantics_contract.continuous_force: only active points have force variables and each force is ordered normal/right/forward
fixed_contact_semantics_contract.friction: normal >= 0 and sqrt(right^2+forward^2) <= (52429/65536) normal for every active force and activation impulse
fixed_contact_semantics_contract.activation: only a newly activated source point may carry a rigid boundary impulse
fixed_contact_semantics_contract.release: point deactivation and complete contact exit apply exact zero impulse

controller_reachability_contract.command_domain: signed integer microradians before the frozen target soft-clamp and slew graph
controller_reachability_contract.target_hold: one commanded target row is held for exactly four ordered 240 Hz physics intervals
controller_reachability_contract.observation: ties-to-even microradian joint-position and microradian-per-second joint-velocity quantization at every physics node
controller_reachability_contract.controller: the exact current fixed-PD gains, descriptor limits and R133 sequential event order
controller_reachability_contract.limiter_state: previous effort persists across all 3200 rows; positive-work state resets only at each 60 Hz motor interval
controller_reachability_contract.envelopes: hard ROM, joint velocity, static effort, 240 Hz effort rate, power and positive work per motor tick remain exact

hybrid_transcription_contract.configuration: root translation, root SO(3) and 23 joint positions represented on their exact manifold with 29-dimensional local updates
hybrid_transcription_contract.ordinary_velocity_update: v_(k+1)=v_bar_(k+1) when the boundary activates no point
hybrid_transcription_contract.activation_momentum_jump: M(q_(k+1))(v_(k+1)-v_bar_(k+1))=sum_new J_xyz(q_(k+1))^T p_new only at the 11 activation boundaries
hybrid_transcription_contract.post_activation_closure: every point active after the boundary satisfies its exact position anchor and J(q_(k+1))v_(k+1)=0
hybrid_transcription_contract.initial_state: exact R120 configuration with the exact R133 projected initial velocity; source hashes must reproduce before any future assembly
hybrid_transcription_contract.interior_reference: R120/R133 state, target and effort arrays are initialization or deviation-reference evidence only, never hard interior equalities
hybrid_transcription_contract.hard_descriptor_bounds: current collider, ROM, generalized velocity and controller envelope checks remain hard and are evaluated from the integrated trajectory

acceptance_semantics_contract.feasibility: all source hashes, exact controller replay, manifold integration, rigid dynamics, sticking closure, activation momentum jumps, individual force/impulse cones and unchanged descriptor bounds pass at every indexed row
acceptance_semantics_contract.continuous_candidate_generator: may propose variables but cannot establish controller reachability or acceptance
acceptance_semantics_contract.claim_ceiling: symbolic fixed-mode feasibility graph and exact inventory only; no implementation conformance, numerical feasibility, native behavior, candidate, corpus or training claim

required_checks: exact 3201-node/3200-interval/motor-to-physics indexing and manifold integration ordering
independent reproduction of all 29 mode transitions, 18 point activations, 18 point releases and source mode hash
synthetic ordinary, activation, release, forefoot-to-flat, flat-to-forefoot and malformed transition residual blocks
synthetic exact fixed-PD quantization, four-step target hold, persistent effort-rate state and per-motor-tick work reset
proof that applied target and effort are derived and cannot be substituted as free variables
proof that inactive force, unscheduled impulse, sliding, compliance and mode-choice blocks are structurally absent
invalid identity, counter, event order and approximation-as-acceptance cases fail closed
